     "subtitle": "Krešo on the album: a surprise that stepped outside the frame of the expected",

     "content": "The conversation about Avangarda's new album veers to the guests, that is, to the featurings. Host Khan notes that on the album the members of the duo played with the guest appearances and stepped out of the box. Along with the usual suspects and part of the lineup that is expected, **Krešo** also appeared. His guest appearance, he says, surprised many. The host immediately sends him a greeting and adds that in this season he might finally come to the podcast as well. He adds that negotiations are reportedly already underway, but that every good word helps.\n\nKhan honestly admits that he did not expect the collaboration: knowing the duo's old catalog, he did not see Krešo as an obvious guest.
